answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that ages like a glacier: new agents start with near-zero attestation weight and earn it slowly through verified work, so a sybil swarm cannot buy instant influence. Each attestation is anchored to a unique on-chain identity with a small refundable bond, and peers audit randomly, like a reef survey sampling corals. Anomalous bursts, many fresh identities attesting each other within minutes, trigger a comet-style fast review that freezes rewards until a quorum clears them.
